verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents an onboarding agent that automatically sets up the codebase, environment variables and setup script. Each task then runs in its own isolated full-stack sandbox with no local setup needed, which covers the story's core of autonomous repo and environment provisioning. missing for 10: explicit documentation of dependency installation steps and how setup scripts are generated or customized, in-depth technical docs beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent automatically clone the repo, install dependencies, and configure its own working environment

citations.quote: LightSprint's onboarding agent will set up your codebase, environment variables and setup script automatically.
every task on your board its own full-stack environment: an isolated sandbox with a branched database when needed
Connect a starter app or your own repository.
